label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: DeChambeau’s Major Outlook
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau said he might miss the cut at all four majors this year but believes his swing is close to his best ever.

items.headline: LPGA Growth Yet Lagging
items.text: Despite massive growth in women's sports, Nelly Korda highlighted that women's golf still feels left behind in fans, media, and sponsorship.

items.headline: Scheffler Nears Money List
items.text: Scottie Scheffler is closing in fast on Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy atop the PGA Tour career money list.
